additional_info.subject: 0430824 - ID0430824-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP/S4170003488] Charger Firmware Update Fails CRM:00314000181
additional_info.body:
Dear Mert,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0430824.
The ticket was opened for issues in updating the FW on #3 chargers.
The issue was that the Hawkbit.conf file was missing from the charger configurations, hence the rollout of the FW from SCB was not successful.
As per requested, I updated the following charger as per instructions:
4WBIAI
updated to FW v7.0.5
qQ9igu
updated to FW v6.1.3
S1UCv5
updated to FW v6.1.3
As chargers
qQ9igu and S1UCv5
are belonging to Borusan EnBW, I also uploaded the EcoG Hotfix v1.4.11 on them.
Since the issue is now solved, I will proceed to close this ticket.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
Kindly note that email responses to closed tickets are not monitored.
Thank you.
